verses.text: God, save me because of who you are. By your strength show that I am innocent.
Hear my prayer, God; listen to what I say.
Strangers turn against me, and cruel people want to kill me. They do not care about God. Selah
See, God will help me; the Lord will support me.
Let my enemies be punished with their own evil. Destroy them because you are loyal to me.
I will offer a sacrifice as a special gift to you. I will thank you, Lord , because you are good.
You have saved me from all my troubles, and I have seen my enemies defeated.
